status: Prospective addendum only. No physical banks, labels, encoder artifacts, outputs or former assessment results accessed to design this probe. No change to earlier trials or their holds. Use only newly issued lineage. No physical fit or score until numbered release AND public SHA256 freeze of actual unlabeled native-pair encoders, not just the design. No networking, GPU, engines generating physical configurations, paid execution or alternate rate/objective. No adjustment after controls.
population: Design.json roles, 128 anchors, the same frozen eligible.npy. All eligible anchors equally weighted, not equal-weighting parent means. Parent-cluster inference includes parents with zero eligible anchors. No parent IDs, anchor ordinal, stratum or other metadata as encoder inputs; no center, word, lookup or Y for label-free/random/occupancy code. Stratum enters only as common baseline and mismatch matching factor. No re-use of prior outcome banks. Only fit Y trains/calibrates. Cannot claim a central order parameter.
offset: Exactly spatial_raw raw-oof-{512,2048}.npz packing_oof and stratum_oof matched by native parent, anchor ordinal and stratum. For deployment use corresponding fit-prefix raw-model-{prefix}.joblib and packing_offsets. Include bare stratum intercept, bare packing ensemble (no code), direct raw supervised primary probabilities via spatial_raw.predict. No outcome refitting of a baseline on development, hot or transfer.
codes: Nominal K=4 in all compressed arms. Native label-free model and random controls: read immutable registered spatial_word encoders. Paired seeds 260511,260512, bounded fit prefixes 512,2048 with updates 256,512,1024. Random = exactly the two frozen initial encoders. Occupancy control: FIT-only vacancy counts on same 386 shell positions, global quartiles via inverted empirical CDF at .25,.5,.75; code = number of cut points strictly below the count, ties retained; no Y, no stratum, no tuned binning. Uses same nominal alphabet, not guaranteed same achieved entropy; do not call this four-symbol occupancy binning supervised packing. Compare H and within-stratum H at each achieved rate; differences exceeding 0.1 nat in either entropy explicitly flag rate mismatch, not attributable solely to task or training.
targeted: Supervised K4 is explicitly trained using fit Y. EXACT shared signed 386 inputs / tanh 32 / 4 logits and Glorot initialization from spatial_word.init_encoder; compute softmax q at temperature 1. Minimize mean over anchors of sum_h q(h|E) * [softplus(b+d_h)-Y*(b+d_h)], b=OOF packing logit; train four scalar head offsets initialized [-1,-1/3,1/3,1] along with encoder, no other loss, penalties or regularizers. Backpropagate through soft q; Adam lr=.001, beta=.9,.999, eps=1e-8, no decay/clipping. Uniform-with-replacement draws of 128 eligible FIT rows per update PCG64(seed+7000), pair starts to native and frozen random seeds, restart each prefix. Same 256/512/1024 update checkpoints; full primary 2048 x 1024, fixed. Hard argmax first; discard soft supervised head. Thus matched capacity, input preprocessing, optimizer, examples/update, starts and budget, not identical target/gradient variance. No Y used by native contrastive encoder; probe sees Y AFTER public hard freeze.
calibration: Every code including supervised, occupancy and both random starts uses the identical hard-only FIT decoder: for each h solve sum_{z=h}(expit(b+d)-y) + 2*d = 0 (ridge penalty d^2 on summed Bernoulli NLL); unique finite root, absent symbols offset zero. Absolute probabilities clip [1e-7,1-1e-7] for every score. No intercept besides the common fitted stratum/packing system. Report probabilities and parent scores per start. Primary native, random, targeted: arithmetic mean of respective two fixed start probabilities (never rank/select); show each start alongside. An ensemble can encode more than two bits; report joint-pair H, H|S, nominal alphabet 16, separately and do not assert the ensemble is a single K4 code. Any claim about a *single* two-bit code is restricted to per-start evidence (require both starts separately clear both material margins; no fallback).
sensitivity: Before any physical targeted interpretation run ONCE an archive-free end-to-end planted numeric control with PCG64(260571), 384 abstract parents x32 rows, first 256 fit/last 128 held; iid Bernoulli(.5) feature bits in 386 dimensions, independent binary S, base=-2+.6*S, known centered linear direction sum(first 64 signed bits)/8. Bernoulli Y from base + 1.5*sign(direction), zero direction uses positive sign. Apply exact init, target objective, updates 1024 x128 with both seeds, argmax, fit-only ridge decoder and probabilities; report hard held gain, achieved entropy and oracle gain. Pass only if each start has >=2 occupied hard symbols with H>=.35 nat and held vs known base lower 95% parent bound >.01 nat; oracle lower bound >.02. Check finite difference gradients on synthetic tiny batch before fit (max absolute error <=1e-6, float64). No post-failure retuning. Failure bars inference on depth/optimization and physical targeted fit; physical comparisons cannot claim targeting-vs-compression mechanism. Control demonstrates sensitivity to this direction/effect only. No native data generation or previous control reuse.
comparisons: For dev all nested prefixes/updates; for cold/hot/transfer ONLY final 2048 x1024 unchanged. Retain conditional entropy, state counts, paired-start scatter, named absolute Bernoulli log scores and differences vs stratum, packing, achievable raw, native label-free and supervised targeted. Log-score ratio of sums across eligible anchors; SE = sqrt(P/(P-1)*sum_j [sum_j(d)-mean(d)*count_j]^2)/sum_j count_j. t(P-1) two-sided 95% CI; effective MDE=2.80 SE; projected MDE to 1024 is conditional sqrt(P/1024) rescale, not a power guarantee. Native-vs-packing dev projected MDE must be <=.001 for material primary. Intersection superiority lower bounds >.001 against BOTH registered bare packing and stratum; gated by full raw, support (>=25% anchors, >=50% positive anchors, >=128 parents with eligible positive and >=128 with eligible negative), primary codes noncollapsed (H>=.35 and >=2 occupied symbols per start), positive physical cold, hot null and unchanged warm confirmation. Other contrasts descriptive with no multiplicity promotion. No relaxation of gates. All scores paired within parent, not independently across seeds.
mismatch: Physical downstream check on each held role: permute the code-bearing eligible shells/rows bijectively within each stratum, independently of Y, holding target, packing offset and decoder fixed. Stratified PCG64(260573) random ordering of parents and of rows inside each parent then cyclic rotation by largest parent block, fail closed if more than half the stratum belongs to one parent. Donor must differ in native parent on EVERY row. Same donor map for either start and all arms, no mixing roles/temperatures; report true-minus-mismatched native probe score with parent uncertainty descriptive conditional on this fixed matching, not unconditional randomization p-values. This supplements, does not replace spatial_word native full-word versus mismatched center discriminant on held data.
beta_zero: Use exact finite-composition catalog (#04 positive occupancy masks; 2400 A,3600 B,2000 vacancies without replacement). On untouched hot evaluate association (Y-P0(S)) * [logit(predicted positive)-logit(packing)] for every arm and primary. Cold predictions need not calibrate hot. Primary 95% parent interval must include 0 and stay within [-.001,.001], AND all-anchor prevalence minus exact finite-composition expectation within 3 parent SE. Report residual SE, MDE and unconditional prevalence. Strict hot admission/interpretation also requires role support. No hot re-fit, no new thresholds, mismatch and hot control address different nulls.
release: Only parent may issue numbered stage release and run each command once. Receipt pins stage, role, serial number and SHA256 of immutable model artifacts. Fit and dev separately, cold/hot/transfer closed; no auto-opening or automatic progression. Freeze fit probe object, source/decoder/calibration hash and all model hashes in public receipt before any exam. Each output created once; a failed started stage cannot silently rerun. Do not launch after discovery cutoff or continue after stop UTC. Contingent scaling, center-rule claims, distillation/transfer promotion not authorized by this CLI. If raw, support, synthetic control, lineage, wall time or parent release blocks a stage, list arms as unscored, not null.
